request: Profit protection OR opposite signal independently closes the position. Continue testing channel parameters and profit protection in the existing project. No fees or slippage.
stages: Evaluate nine widths with protection off on first year; evaluate six protection rules on baseline width 31 / 0.99 on first year.

Pick width by first-year return/max drawdown, eligible if return positive, profit factor >1 and at least 50 trades; baseline participates. Then apply all six protection settings to that one selected width; no other width/protection combinations are searched.
Pick a first-year protection candidate on each of the baseline and selected widths using the same criterion; retain the no-protection version in the ranking so adding protection is not mandatory.
Lock the choices before evaluating later historical periods. Report every candidate in full, validation and recent, and compare neighboring widths. Do not reselect using later returns.
execution: Close crossing signal, next-open execution. Same-side signals do not add to held positions. Opposite signal always closes held side even if the chase limit prevents the new entry.
Protection activation is favorable excursion as percent of actual entry price. Giveback is a percentage of maximum unrealized profit, not a percentage of peak market price.

At every completed 15m candle, use all favorable highs/lows observed while still holding to update maximum excursion. At or above activation, protect (1-giveback/100) of that excursion. The line only tightens; new line takes effect from the next candle. This is a 15m update simulation, not tick-by-tick trailing.
Previously effective protection can execute during a candle. Opening gaps crossing the line fill at the actual open. Do not use that candle's later high/low to improve its earlier exit.

At an open, active protection is checked before pending signal execution. If both can close, close only once; a qualifying pending opposite entry may still open the new side. End-of-backtest forced close remains a bookkeeping exception.
After protection exit, the next newly confirmed valid crossing can reopen; do not reopen simply because price remains outside the band. A fresh signal formed on the exit candle may execute next open.
No extra fixed stop, fixed take-profit or from-entry trailing stop. No fees, slippage or leverage.
required_analysis: Report trades, wins/losses, return, maximum drawdown, average win/loss, exit causes, side attribution, monthly outcomes and the recent weak period.

For matched entry time/direction, compare baseline trades to the first corresponding protected trade: saved losing trades, curtailed winning trades, average change and unmatched/extra entries. Separately calculate excursions on the fixed baseline holding interval to assess protection independent of changed re-entry paths.
Verify disabled protection exactly reproduces baseline trades/equity; hand-test long/short activation, monotonic line, gap, either-exit rule, collision and reset.
limits: All two-year history has already been inspected. These are exploratory historical parameter tests, not untouched or prospective validation. First-year choices must be reported even if later outcomes disappoint. No continuous parameter optimization or additional markets.
